details.headline: Implementing Paxos for Fault-Tolerant Distributed Systems
details.problem: Distributed systems risk data inconsistency and downtime during node failures. The challenge was to build a key-value store that could automatically maintain consensus and recover from failures without data loss.
details.solution: I implemented the Paxos consensus algorithm to manage a replicated state machine across the cluster. To manage the nodes, I leveraged Kubernetes StatefulSets to provide stable network identities and persistent storage, which is crucial for Paxos participants. The entire infrastructure was automated as code using Terraform.

impact.text: Faster failover recovery rate vs. baseline (reduced from 10 seconds to 6 seconds using Paxos consensus)
Data consistency maintained under simulated network partitions (tested with 50+ partition scenarios)
Reduction in manual deployment time via IaC (from 40 minutes to 10 minutes using Terraform automation)

techHighlight.title: Code Spotlight: Kubernetes StatefulSet Configuration
techHighlight.code:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: paxos-acceptor
spec:
  serviceName: "paxos-acceptor-svc"
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: paxos-acceptor
  template:
    # ... (Pod specifications)
  volumeClaimTemplates:
  - metadata:
      name: paxos-storage
    spec:
      accessModes: [ "ReadWriteOnce" ]
      storageClassName: "aws-ebs-gp3"
      resources:
        requests:
          storage: 10Gi

points.title: StatefulSet Kind
points.description: Guarantees the ordering and uniqueness of Pods, essential for maintaining stable identities in consensus protocols.

points.title: serviceName
points.description: Links the StatefulSet to a Headless Service, providing direct DNS resolution for peer-to-peer communication between nodes.

points.title: replicas: 3
points.description: Configured to tolerate F=1 failure (Byzantine Fault Tolerance requires 2F+1 nodes), ensuring a quorum can always be reached.

points.title: volumeClaimTemplates
points.description: Automatically provisions persistent storage (AWS EBS) for each replica, ensuring state survives pod restarts.
